quality.review_scope: All local main and matching SI pages; source-scoped recipes, analytical contexts and retained source conflicts. No complete-paper Reader or unsupported atomistic model assigned.
missing_fields: Unreported gas flow/pressure, stirring speed, exact rapid-injection duration, cooling time, workup volumes, rotor radius, storage and isolated mass yield remain missing.
No atomic coordinates, exact EDTA binding pose or measured particle facet indices are reported. Author mechanistic schemes are interpretations; no atomic model is assigned.
Source graphs are retained without digitization. Numerical curve ordinates and unprinted fit parameters are not inferred.
Physical aliquot/batch equivalence across UV–visible, TEM, XRD and NMR is not established. Products identify source-named analytical contexts, not proven shared aliquots.
SI yield calculations use an unreported numerical optical path length, bulk absorption coefficient and molar volume. External cited methods are not imported.
conflicts: Main p.3 says the ligand-peak/(111) XRD ratio increases as particle size decreases, whereas SI p.5 Figure S4 caption says decreases. Printed ratios 0.013, 0.252 and 3.305 are retained with their EDTA labels; the caption is not silently repaired.
For 0.75 equivalent EDTA, main p.3 reports LEET 393 nm whereas SI p.16 Tauc annotation reads 3.14 eV = 395 nm. These are distinct source estimates, not averaged or recalculated.

SI Figure S12 calls the ammonium-related shift upfield although its arrows and the larger-ppm discussion in the main text point the other way. Preserve the wording conflict without changing the spectrum.
